about: Reception counter modelled as a generic product: raised HPL fascia with feature band and quartz ledge, laminated glass screen on posts with pass slot and speech grille, lowered accessible section with knee space and hearing loop sign, staff worktop, pedestal with handles, cable tray, grommets, power/data module, end panels, plinth. Geometry is drawn at the 2400_Accessible type; the other types share it until a parametric pass. Reference: query: casework reception counter accessible casework hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=casework+reception+counter+accessible+casework+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
